body.objective: Students will be able to name school subjects.
successCriteria: I can name school subjects in Mandarin
I can say which subjects I like and dislike
I can ask a classmate about their favourite subject
body.hook: What's your favourite class? In China, students study many of the same subjects you do: Chinese, math, science, English and PE. Learning to talk about your school subjects lets you compare your school day with a student in Beijing or Shanghai.

study.title: 你最喜欢什么课？
study.question: How do I talk about school subjects in Mandarin?
study.passage:
More subjects: 历史 lìshǐ (history), 音乐 yīnyuè (music), 美术 měishù (art), 法文 Fǎwén (French).
Sentence patterns:
• 我喜欢数学。Wǒ xǐhuan shùxué. = I like math.
• 我不喜欢历史。Wǒ bù xǐhuan lìshǐ. = I don't like history.
• 你最喜欢什么课？Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme kè? = What is your favourite class?
• 我最喜欢体育课。Wǒ zuì xǐhuan tǐyù kè. = My favourite is PE class.
• 为什么？Wèishénme? = Why? 因为… yīnwèi… = Because…
Dialogue:
小明 Xiǎo Míng：你最喜欢什么课？
安娜 Ānnà：我最喜欢美术课。你呢？
小明：我最喜欢数学课。
安娜：为什么？
小明：因为数学很有意思。
安娜：我不喜欢数学，太难了！
English support: 你呢？nǐ ne? = And you? 很有意思 hěn yǒu yìsi = very interesting. 太难了 tài nán le = too hard!
Activity: Ask five classmates "你最喜欢什么课？" and record answers in a tally chart. Report: "三个同学最喜欢体育课。" (Sān gè tóngxué zuì xǐhuan tǐyù kè = Three classmates like PE class most.)
study.source: Original dialogue written for this lesson.
steps: Practise the 喜欢 and 不喜欢 patterns
Read the dialogue with a partner
discussion: What is Xiǎo Míng's favourite class, and why?
How do you make 喜欢 negative?
What does 你呢 mean, and when do you use it?
study.product: Write five sentences in characters and pinyin about your school subjects: two you like, one you don't, your favourite with a reason (因为), and one question for a classmate.

examples.title: Negative
examples.answer: 我不喜欢音乐。Wǒ bù xǐhuan yīnyuè.

examples.title: Favourite
examples.answer: 我最喜欢美术课。Wǒ zuì xǐhuan měishù kè.

examples.title: Reason
examples.answer: 因为体育很有意思。Yīnwèi tǐyù hěn yǒu yìsi.

practice.q: What does 喜欢 xǐhuan mean?
How do you make 喜欢 negative?
practice.a: Put 不 bù before it: 不喜欢.

practice.q: What does 为什么 wèishénme mean?
Why does Xiǎo Míng like math?
Translate 太难了 tài nán le.
Report: two classmates like music most.
practice.a: 两个同学最喜欢音乐课。Liǎng gè tóngxué zuì xǐhuan yīnyuè kè.

practice.q: Why is 两 liǎng used instead of 二 èr before 个?
practice.a: 两 is used for "two" before measure words.

misconceptions: Using 二 instead of 两 before a measure word
exitTicket: Say your favourite subject in Mandarin.
Ask a classmate about their favourite class.

items.q: Name four school subjects in Mandarin.
items.answer: 数学, 科学, 英文, 体育.

items.q: Write "I like math, but I don't like history." in characters.
items.answer: 我喜欢数学，但是我不喜欢历史。

items.q: Ask and answer: What is your favourite class?
items.answer: 你最喜欢什么课？我最喜欢…课。
Before the verb: 我不喜欢.

items.q: Give a reason with 因为.
items.answer: Sample: 因为音乐很有意思。

items.q: Write five sentences about your school subjects.
Report a survey result using 个.
items.answer: Answers vary; e.g. 三个同学最喜欢体育课。
